title: mcp-extension.json
description: Root descriptor for an mcp-ade extension. Must be placed at the root of the extension directory.

enabled.description: Whether the extension is enabled by default. Defaults to true. Set to false for extensions that require additional setup before use.

extensionStructure.description: Expected directory layout for an mcp-ade extension
notes: An extension can have multiple LSP and/or DAP servers
lsp/ and dap/ directories are optional — an extension can have only LSP, only DAP, or both
Use the add_extension tool with the extension folder path to register it
